# Fixture glossary

Invented entries that tests/glossary.sh checks the fixture files against.

## courier

Someone who carries a parcel between two towns; this meaning line may name runner and signal freely.

Avoid: runner, parcel carrier, signal

## tide

The sea's rise and fall at the harbor wall.

Avoid (whole phrase): drift, low water

## harbor

The port, the boats in it, or a shelter from the wind.

Ambiguous: say which of the three is meant.
Avoid: none
